name: Bossa
description: A woman in her mid forties, a Brazilian bossa nova singer who sings barely above a whisper, warm and unhurried.
build: A slender, softly curved adult build of ordinary proportions: relaxed sloping shoulders, a natural waist, arms and legs of ordinary length, standing upright with easy straight knees.
face: Golden-tan skin, dark brown almond eyes under softly arched dark brows, a straight nose, high cheekbones, full lips, faint laugh lines at the eyes, and large round gold hoop earrings.
hair: Thick wavy dark-brown hair to the shoulders, parted at the centre and tucked behind both ears, falling behind the shoulders clear of the arms.
outfit: A sleeveless off-the-shoulder linen top in warm ivory with a wide straight neckline across both bare shoulders, loosely tucked in; high-waisted wide-leg linen trousers in deep terracotta ending at the ankle; a slim tan leather belt; flat tan leather sandals with wide straps. Both arms and hands are bare. Her head is bare.
performance_style: Soft and still: feet close together, weight on the character-left leg with the character-right knee eased. Both arms hang loosely, the character-right and character-left hands open and empty beside the hips, fingers visible. Head tilted slightly, eyes half-lidded, a faint calm smile.
location: A small open-air terrace in Rio at dusk: pale stone floor tiles running to the bottom of the frame, a low white wall with potted palms, a wooden bar stool with no one on it, and a lilac-orange evening sky over a dark hill.
recognition_cues: shoulder-length wavy dark hair and big gold hoops
avoid: a hat or flower in the hair

sing.intent: Hushed bossa vocal loop: the mic in the character-right hand held close under the lips, the character-left hand drawing a slow small wave at waist height, the hips swaying gently side to side, eyes half-closed, then settle back to the soft stance. The mouth must visibly open and change shape across the loop so she unmistakably reads as singing.

animations.flinch: Brief surprise at a room sound: the eyes widen, the shoulders rise a little and the character-left hand touches the collarbone, then she softens back into the relaxed stance. No opponent or contact.
animations.guard: One-shot stage self-protection: draw the feet together and fold both forearms loosely across the waist, hands open, then hold a calm poised finish. Not combat.
animations.entrance: One-shot entrance: stroll in with a slow swaying step, stop square to the front and settle into the soft stance, both hands open at her hips.
animations.victory: One-shot finish: place the character-right open hand on the heart, open the character-left hand out low to the side, tip the head and give a warm closed-mouth smile, then hold.
animations.ko: Non-contact performance defeat: the sway stops, the shoulders sag, both open hands hang still and the head bows with the eyes closed. She holds a standing, quietly deflated finish. She remains standing on both feet in every frame — no kneeling, crouching, sitting, sinking or going to the ground. No impact, injury or opponent.
